title: Missing ConfigMap
brief: A shop release is not starting. Find the affected Application and the warning on its pod.

checks.question: Which Application matches this incident?
checks.hint: Filter by the environment in the briefing.
checks.why: The Applications list distinguishes staging from production.

checks.question: Which ConfigMap name is the pod trying to load?
checks.hint: Read the pod's most recent warning event.
checks.why: Events explain why Kubernetes could not start the pod.

truth.cause: The deployment references a ConfigMap that does not exist
truth.fix: Restore the ConfigMap reference in git
